title: Hand tools arranged in a drawer
visual_facts: An open red tool cabinet drawer has a fitted black foam insert.
The drawer holds several pliers and cutters with red handles, plus a pair of blue and black handled pliers.
A narrow black tool with small printed markings is positioned near the center.
The tools are arranged in individual cutouts in the foam.
spatial_relations: The tools lie side by side across the drawer, with three long pliers along the front edge.
uncertainties: Some small tool markings are not legible.
The exact types of several pliers cannot be determined from this view.
